title: Defect-directed regeneration of LiCoO2 cathodes via gradient cobalt reprogramming
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE02083F, Paper
Siyu Zhang, Yangyang Liu, Gen Chen, Yuping Fan, Hamdy Khamees Thabet, Yu Yao, Zhuoxi Wu, Bingan Lu, Junwei Han, Jiang Zhou
Defect-directed regeneration reprograms spent LiCoO2 cathodes into a gradient cobalt architecture, enabling high-voltage stability and performance beyond the pristine material.
